idea-plugin.name: Agent CLI
idea-plugin.description:
• Agent CLI tool window with an embedded terminal and a compact session sidebar.
  • Support for Claude Code, Cursor agent, OpenAI Codex and Gemini CLI — start a session for the agent you use from the + menu.
  • Multiple sessions — create, switch, and close sessions; session history for the current project with resume by session ID where local agent data is available.
  • Theme-aware terminal — colors follow the IDE look-and-feel where applicable.
  • Settings (Settings → Tools → Agent CLI) — configure each agent's launch command and terminal font size.

Note: A JetBrains Runtime with JCEF is required for the embedded terminal. Install and sign in to each agent CLI you use separately.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.1

  • Fixed the timer logic in the history panel.
  • Shipped follow-up metadata and documentation updates as part of the patch release.
  • Added Codex as a supported agent type across the plugin.
  • Added a dedicated Codex history reader and wired Codex sessions into the sidebar, panel, and deletion flow.
  • Expanded settings and internal architecture to support the new agent cleanly.
  • Optimized history file parsing across supported agents to improve responsiveness.
  • Added a loading screen for terminal initialization and history-related UI states.
  • Fixed rendering and parsing issues in the terminal and history UI.
